fields.Name: T51 - Entity Form View Product
fields.Description: Verifies that a Product record opens into its full editable entity form with populated fields, confirming the form rendering pipeline works for the Products entity.

InputDefinition.goal: Navigate to Data Explorer and open the 'Products' entity from the entity tree. Click a product row in the grid (e.g. Burrata or Extra Sharp Cheddar), then click the 'Open Full Record' button to load the full product form in a tab. Reach the state where the form is fully rendered with populated fields such as the product name and cheese type. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment, so wait for loads to finish rather than navigating away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The full Products record form is displayed in a tab, not just the grid preview panel
Form fields show populated product data such as a name and a cheese-type value
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
